_comment: Lab fleet: the real Keysight E4360A mainframes. One unit = one output channel of one mainframe. transport 'auto' tries the documented VXI-11 path first, then the raw socket on 'port', and pins whichever answers. Used only to seed an empty data.db; edit units afterwards from Configuration -> Simulator Units. For a no-hardware demo start the backend with SAS_FLEET_FILE=fleet.emulator.json.
